ja519:1.1: Kā vedhamānā girikandarāyaṃ ekā tuvaṃ tiṭṭhasi saññatūru, puṭṭhāsi me pāṇipameyyamajjhe, akkhāhi me nāmañ ca bandhave ca.
ja519:2.1: Obhāsayaṃ vanaṃ rammaṃ sīhavyagghanisevitaṃ kā vā tvam asi kalyāṇi, kassa vā tvaṃ sumajjhime, abhivādemi taṃ bhadde, dānav' āhaṃ, nam' atthu te ti.
ja519:3.1: Yo putto Kāsirājassa Sotthiseno ti taṃ vidū tassāhaṃ Sambulā bhariyā, evaṃ jānāhi dānava, [abhivādemi taṃ bhante, Sambulāhaṃ, nam' atthu te ti].
ja519:4.1: Vedehaputto bhaddan te vane vasati āturo, tam ahaṃ rogasammattaṃ ekā ekaṃ upaṭṭh' ahaṃ.
ja519:5.1: Ahañ ca vanam uñchāya madhumaṃsaṃ migābilaṃ. yadā harāmi taṃ bhakkho, tassa nūn' ajja nādhatīti.
ja519:6.1: Kiṃ vane rājaputtena āturena karissasi Sambule pariciṇṇena, ahaṃ bhattā bhavāmi te.
ja519:7.1: Sokaṭṭāya durattāya kiṃ rūpaṃ vijjate mama, aññaṃ pariyesa bhaddan te abhirūpataraṃ mayā.
ja519:8.1: Ehi maṃgirim āruyha, bhariyā mayhaṃ catussatā, tāsaṃ tvaṃ pavarā hohi sabbakāmasamiddhinī.
ja519:9.1: Nanu hāṭakavaṇṇābhe yaṃ kiñci manas' icchasi sabban taṃ pacuraṃ mayhaṃ, ramasv-ajja mayā saha.
ja519:10.1: No ce tuvaṃ maheseyyaṃ Sambule kārayissasi alaṃ tvaṃ pātarāsāya maññe bhakkhā bhavissasi.
ja519:11.1: Tañ ca sattajaṭo luddo kaḷāro purisādako vane nāthaṃ apassantiṃ Sambulaṃ aggahī bhuje.
ja519:12.1: Adhipannā pisācena luddenāmisacakkhunā sā ca sattuvasam pattā patim evānusocati.
ja519:13.1: Na me idaṃ tathā dukkhaṃ yaṃ maṃ khādeyya rakkhaso yañ ce me ayyaputtassa mano hessati aññathā.
ja519:14.1: Na santi devā, pavasanti nūna, (II 123|15) na ha nūna santi idha lokapālā, sahasā karontānaṃ asaññatānaṃ na ha nūna santi paṭisedhitāro
ja519:15.1: ti. Itthīnam esā pavarā yasassinī santā samā aggi-r-iv' uggatejā, tañ ce tuvaṃ rakkhasādesi kaññaṃ muddhā va hi sattadhā te phaleyya, mā tvaṃ jahī muñca patibbatā yā 'ti.
ja519:16.1: Sā ca assamam āgañchi pamuttā purisādakā nīḷaṃ phalinasakuṇīva gatasiṃgaṃ va ālayaṃ.
ja519:17.1: Sā tattha paridevesi rājaputtī yasassinī Sambulā utumattakkhā vane nāthaṃ apassantī:
ja519:18.1: Samaṇe brāhmaṇe vande sampannacaraṇe ise. rājaputtaṃ apassantī tumhaṃ hi saraṇaṃ gatā.
ja519:19.1: Vande sīhe ca vyagghe ca ye ca aññe vane migā rājaputtaṃ etc. Tiṇalatāni
ja519:23.1: Vande ahaṃ [pabbata]-rājaseṭṭhaṃ Himavantaṃ siluccayaṃ etc, Atisāyaṃ
ja519:24.1: vatāgañchi rājaputti yasassini, kena nu jja samāgañchi, ko te piyataro mayā
ja519:25.1: ti. Idaṃ kho 'haṃ tadāvocaṃ gahitā tena sattunā, na me idaṃ tathā dukkhaṃ yaṃ maṃ khadeyya rakkhaso yañ ce me ayyaputtassa mano hessati aññathā ti g. ā.
ja519:26.1: Corīnaṃ bahubuddhīnaṃ yāsu saccaṃ sudullabhaṃ thīnaṃ bhāvo durājāno macchassevodake gatan
ja519:27.1: ti. Tathā maṃ saccaṃ pāletu pālayissati ce mamaṃ yathāhaṃ nābhijānāmi aññaṃ piyataraṃ tayā, etena saccavajjena vyādhi te vūpasammatū 'ti g. ā.
ja519:28.1: Ye kuñjarā sattasatā uḷārā rakkhanti rattindivam uyyutāvudhā dhanuggahānañ ca satāni soḷasa kathaṃvidhe passati bhadde sattavo ti g. ā.
ja519:29.1: Alaṃkatāyo padumuttarattacā virāgitā passati haṃsagaggarā, tāsaṃ suṇitvā mitagītavādinaṃ na 'dāni me tāta tathā yathā pure.
ja519:30.1: Suvaṇṇasaṃkaccadharā suviggahā alaṃkatā mānusiy' accharūpamā senūpiyā tāta aninditaṅgiyo khattiyakaññā paṭilābhayanti naṃ.
ja519:31.1: Sace ahaṃ tāta tathā yathā pure patīta uñchāya punā vane bhare sammānaye maṃ na ca maṃ vimānaye ito pi me tāta tato varaṃ siyā.
ja519:32.1: Yaṃ annapāne vipulasmi ohite nārī vimaṭṭhābharaṇā alaṃkatā sabbaṅgupetā patino va appiyā ābajjha tassā maraṇaṃ tato varaṃ.
ja519:33.1: Api ce daḷiddā kapaṇā anāḷhiyā kālādutīyā patino ca sā piyā sabbaṅgupetāya pi appiyāya ayam eva seyyā kapaṇāpi yā piyā ti.
ja519:34.1: Sudullabh' itthī purisassa yā hitā, bhatt' itthiyā dullabho yo hito ca, hitā ca te sīlavatī ca bhāriyā, janinda dhammañ cara Sambulāyā 'ti gātham āha.
ja519:35.1: Sace tuvaṃ vipule laddhabhoge issāvatiṇṇā maraṇaṃ upesi ahañ ca te bhadde imā ca kaññā sabbe va te vacanakarā bhavāmā 'ti.
